name: Kozukuri Harem Bitch Gakuen
original_name: コヅクリはーれむビッチ学園
source:
The heroines have promised to marry the protagonist. By chance, they all end up at the same school.
With the help of the school's chairman, the protagonist has to decide which one to make his bride.

Two beautiful female students compete to serve him in their swimsuits!

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro-touch/work/=/product_id/VJ007704.html/]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
女主角们已经答应嫁给主角。一次偶然的机会，他们都进入了同一所学校。
在学校主席的帮助下，主角必须决定让哪一位成为他的新娘。

两个漂亮女学生争着穿泳衣服侍他！
